note: Invented calls. expect: the value that should be suggested after the whole call; null = nothing should be suggested; a missing key is not scored. after: the same, after line N (1-based).

lines: Hi, I ordered a tail light for my Vera last week.
When will it arrive?
Hello, I've got a Ridge.
The bonnet got hit by a falling branch, there's a dent in the middle.
It's the mirror on the passenger side of my Atto.
The housing cracked when I clipped a post.
Yeah hi, it's an auto, the compact SUV.
The back bumper is scuffed, just cosmetic.
Someone keyed my Vera last night.
Both front doors have long scratches.
Ridge pickup, I got rear-ended hard on the highway.
The tailgate is completely smashed in.
I need a grille for an Atto.
Sorry, I mean the Vera, my wife drives the Atto.
The front fender on my Atto is pushed in.
Actually no, it's further back, the panel behind the rear door.
Can I get a price for a headlamp on a Vera?
Not sure which side yet, my son took the car.
How much is a fog light?
The headlight on my Ridge is fine.
It's the fog light below it that's cracked, on the right.
Hi, is this the parts desk?
Great, give me a second, I'm just parking.
I want to return a hood I bought for my Atto.
It was the wrong one, how do I get a refund?
Ridge truck, I hit a deer head-on.
The radiator is leaking and the core support is bent, the airbags went off.
The driver's side back door on my Vera has a big dent from a shopping cart.
